policy: Every non-DISTINCT relationship between findings is a recorded human decision with rationale, decider, and date. Derivation applies decisions and creates none of its own: similar titles, matching components, or identical error text justify a recorded suspicion, never an automatic merge. Decisions are reversible - a later decision about the same pair supersedes the earlier one and both are preserved - and no report or finding is ever deleted by deduplication; a deduplicated finding still names every source report individually.
note: Zero decisions. An empty list means no relationship has been decided, never that all findings are unrelated.
